can_label.fine: Contents under pressure. Keep away from heat, sparks and open flame. Do not pierce or burn, even when empty. Use in a ventilated place. Shake for one minute before use. Prismatik Coatings.

tags.description: A dented aerosol can in Prismatik house colours, the label worn down to the hazard diamond. PRISMATIK. ONE CAN. EVERY COLOUR. A mixing head draws from four pigment cells and a white, and the collar clicks through the range as you turn it. It rattles when you pick it up. That's the only gauge it has.
